name: Joomla
description: Joomla is an open-source content management system for building websites, from blogs and company sites to community portals. It manages articles, categories, menus and media, with fine-grained user groups and access levels, built-in multilingual content and a web services API. Templates control the look, and thousands of extensions add shops, forms, galleries and more.

notes.text: Log in at http://<IP>/administrator with the admin user and the generated password from /opt/joomla_data/.env inside the container.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: At least 12 characters, generated when left empty
